name: foresight-dr-m2
task: 5-class diabetic retinopathy grading with referable-DR probability

input.description: one RGB fundus photograph, preprocessed exactly as `preprocess` below

logits.note: apply softmax; referable_prob = sum of classes index >= 2

reg.note: auxiliary regression estimate of the grade (0..4)

features.shape: [1, C, h, w] (ONNX) / [1, h, w, C] (TFLite)
features.note: last conv feature map; heat map for class k = sum_c head.class_weights[k][c] * features[c]

bias_report.by_age_group: not available: APTOS has no age labels
bias_report.known_gaps: limited images from Latino and Vietnamese populations in public data (spec §6)

intended_use: Screening-grade estimate of diabetic retinopathy severity from a single fundus photograph taken with the Foresight smartphone adapter, used only to decide whether to recommend a follow-up eye exam. Output is one of three referral outcomes (green / yellow / red) plus a per-eye grade in plain language. Not for diagnosis, treatment decisions, or use without a human referral path.
limitations: CLASSROOM RUN (--small): 224 px, 3 epochs, APTOS only. Weak by design, for learning the pipeline. Not for use with people.

Trained on public datasets photographed with clinical fundus cameras; phone-adapter images differ in field of view, illumination and sharpness. Phase 2 adds adapter-style augmentation and a resolution ablation to quantify this gap.
Public datasets under-represent Latino and Vietnamese populations and rarely record age; bias metrics are reported only where labels exist.
Ungradable images must be caught by the quality model (M1) before this model runs; this model has no 'ungradable' output and will produce a grade for any input.
Diabetic macular edema is not modeled separately; 'referable' is derived from grade >= moderate only.
disclaimer: Foresight is a screening tool operated by students. It is not a medical diagnosis. Please see a healthcare provider.
